nom: Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

avis.texte: First off, I can say my skin is pretty sensitive. I've tried a lot of lotions over the years, and generally, my skin will burn if it's extremely dry. Aveeno does not cause any burning at all. It does a fantastic job of keeping my problem areas moisturized and redness away. The unscented variant doesn't carry any noticeable scent for me, and as a man, I really appreciate that. I use this variant primarily on my face even though it says "body lotion." I find it to be non-greasy, fast aborbing and effective at keeping my skin moisturized for many hours. That said, the dispenser is garbage. Easily leaves a 1/2 cup of the product at the bottom. I transfer it to a small tupperware container with a lid once the pump stops working. That's enough for my little spots for weeks. Still, 5 stars. Aveeno is a wonder product for me.

I’ve been using this Aveeno lotion for a while now, and I can honestly say it’s one of the best lotions I’ve tried. My skin tends to get really dry, and this has made such a noticeable difference. It’s very moisturizing without feeling heavy or greasy, and it absorbs quickly, which I love especially when I’m in a rush. What I appreciate most is how gentle it is. It doesn’t irritate my skin at all, and it actually helps soothe dryness and rough patches. After consistent use, my skin feels softer, smoother, and more hydrated throughout the day. The only small downside for me is that it can feel just a tiny bit thick when you first apply it, but once it sinks in, it feels great and comfortable on the skin. Overall, I’m really happy with this lotion and will definitely keep repurchasing. It’s reliable, effective, and perfect for everyday use!

avis.titre: A Moisturizer I Keep Buying Again and Again
avis.texte: Aveeno has been a staple in my home for years, and this lotion is one of the reasons why. It does an excellent job moisturizing dry skin without feeling greasy or heavy. It absorbs quickly, leaves my skin feeling soft, and provides lasting hydration throughout the day. I especially appreciate that it's gentle enough for sensitive skin and has a light, clean scent that isn't overpowering. The large bottle lasts a long time, making it a great value for everyday use. If you're looking for a reliable daily moisturizer that keeps skin feeling smooth and hydrated, this is a product I would definitely recommend. I've purchased it multiple times and will continue to do so.

avis.titre: Keeps My Skin Soft and Hydrated All Day!
avis.texte: This has become one of my favorite daily body lotions. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky feeling, and it keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day. My skin feels noticeably softer after regular use, especially during dry weather. The lotion has a light, pleasant feel and is gentle enough for everyday use. A little goes a long way, and the bottle lasts quite a while, making it a good value. Overall, it's an excellent moisturizer that delivers lasting hydration and leaves my skin feeling smooth and healthy. I would definitely buy it again.

avis.titre: My favorite lotion at a great price
avis.texte: Love this moisturizer. It's thick and creamy. This lotion is fragrance-free so it doesn't give me a headache like most scented lotions do. It's usually pretty expensive in the stores so when I saw the Aveeno Body Lotion on sale during Prime Days, I took the opportunity to buy two bottles at basically half the price. I especially like the pump nozzle, making it easy to use after washing my hands or taking a shower.

I’m a man, and I moisturize. That said, I’ve tried lots and lots of major brands. All were fine, but Aveeno is superb. Not the least bit oily-feeling, absorbing quickly into just-showered skin, and no bothersome fragrance. My search for the perfect moisturizing lotion is over. I’m an Aveeno customer for life.

I've tried more body lotions than I care to admit and this one stands out from the rest. My skin used to feel dry and tight no matter what I used, and this actually fixes it instead of just masking it for a few hours. My mother swears by it too, she's been using it for a while now and won't touch anything else. The consistency is rich without being heavy, not too thick and not too watery, and a little goes a long way. The ingredients feel clean and gentle, no harsh additives, just genuinely good for your skin. It sinks in fast without leaving that greasy film a lot of lotions leave behind, and being fragrance free means it never irritates my skin even with daily use. Within a day or two of regular use my skin actually feels soft and hydrated instead of dry and flaky. It's basically become part of my daily routine at this point, my skin genuinely looks and feels healthier because of it. Great value for an 18 ounce bottle that lasts a long time. If you deal with normal to dry skin, do yourself a favor and grab this. It's the real deal.

This is the best body lotion I've ever used. It soaks into my skin almost immediately. And over 24 hours later my skin still feels super soft & moisturized. This will be what I'll be using from now on.

avis.titre: Best body lotion I’ve ever used
avis.texte: This is honestly the best body lotion I’ve ever used. It’s incredibly soft, very economical, and the hydration lasts well into the next day. My skin feels smoother, calmer, and deeply nourished after every use.
i love this moisturizer because it goes long way and it actually deep moisturize your skin

avis.texte: The product is affordable and absorbs quickly after use; I really like it.
It's very moisturizing and feels comfortable on the skin. There’s basically no scent, which is exactly what I wanted. Good for daily use.
Es muy bueno llevo varios años usando y mi piel está magnífica
This is a great value for the size of the bottle. It would cost several more dollars at my local store. The wash it self makes my skin feel soft, it smells great and makes my skin smooth.

La Loción Corporal Hidratante Diaria con Avena Calmante de Aveeno es una hidratante corporal ligera y no grasa que nutre profundamente la piel seca y sensible gracias a su fórmula con avena calmante. Se absorbe rápido, ayuda a reforzar la barrera natural de la piel y proporciona hidratación duradera (hasta 48 h clínicamente probadas), dejando la piel suave y confortable sin fragancia ni irritación. Usuarios valoran que no deja sensación pegajosa y funciona bien incluso para piel sensible o con tendencia a eczema
La crema humecta bastante, no tiene olor(en este caso) pero la verdad para pieles resecas es exelente.

I cannot open the cap of the bottle, twisting to left or right and pull does not work. I just have to discard opening this way but pour the contents to my hand, not user-friendly. The contents should be ok but haven’t started to use it yet.

I’ve been using this lotion every day and love how soft and hydrated my skin feels. It’s fragrance-free, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly — perfect for sensitive skin. The oat formula really helps calm dryness and irritation. No breakouts, no sticky feeling. Great size and quality.
Heels started drying up. Rubbed this over my feet and instantly I got silky feefees again! Look how shiny my bottoms are! 👣 No pedis needed with this lotion!

I LOVE this lotion! I use it every day after I shower. It isn’t greasy or oil yet moisturizes my skin. It has a great feel to it. It is unscented so no strong odors. I purchase it (and only it) regularly as far as lotions are concerned .

Aveeno is the one brand that has yet to let me down. The quality of their lotion is amazing. It’s not heavy on the fragrance and focuses more on moisturizing the skin. The lotion is pretty thick so you don’t need much when you go to apply it and when you do it goes on easily because of how smooth it is.
I love Aveeno lotion, it is giving me fresh feeling whenever i put it on my skin

avis.texte: I purchased this product many times because it is a good lotion of long lasting moisturizer for dry skin. Glad that the delivery package has been improved with anti-leak sticker applied to the pump. So that it did not come with leakage this time.

I like this product it’s a good product daily moisturizer body lotion

Aveeno Daiky Moisturizing Lotion is hands down the best, it's goes on non greasy and absorbs well, skin stays soft and hydrated all day

avis.titre: This body lotion actually saved my face!
avis.texte: I am here to say this body lotion literally saved my face!! My face is extremely sensitive, I‘be tried so many products, this body lotion is actually the holly product for my face!! I am hoping they will not change the formula so I can keep using it forever!

I’ve been using this moisturizer for years now and absolutely love it. It’s creamy without feeling greasy or heavy. It has virtually no scent, which I appreciate. And it’s great on sensitive skin. I always put it on my legs right after I shave, and it feels great. I use this all over my body. Though I usually use a face-specific moisturizer on my face, I’ve used this one before and it didn’t cause any breakouts or issues. It’s very moisturizing without being greasy, and it doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin. I’ve been through several bottles of this stuff myself, and I bought another bottle to keep on the counter in our guest bathroom, and my guests always appreciate it.

This lotion arrived quickly. Recommended by dermatologist due to it containing distearyldimonium chloride. I use lotion daily and I noticed this one doesn't leave a nasty ring after baths. My new go to lotion.
Product is good. Shipping is not. Shipped one without nozzle, I have to return and replace it. Defeats the whole purpose of buying on Amazon.

This lotion left a waxy texture on my skin. My hand would not glide smoothly across my skin while applying the lotion. A waxy texture could still be felt the next day. It even left my hand with bruised spots!! See image. It bruised after one application. I’ve used another brand for years without issues. First time trying Aveeno. Thought I’d go with something more economical this time. Unfortunately, this moisturizer didn’t suit me. My skin doesn’t feel silky smooth after applying.
The product is very good. I use it wherever I want as a moisturizer.
No smell, does not irritate my skin and it leaves my skin very moisturized

would've given this 5 stars but the packaging sucks. it arrived with the cap unscrewed and lotion all over the bag (picture below). it was really annoying to have to clean it up and lotion got everywhere. I'm sure some people prefer i scented lotion but i prefer scented. i didn't realize this was unscented when i got it but that's my own fault! overall the lotion is very mouisurizing and soothing. it's a very big bottle--amazing price for the quantity (i included a picture with a quarter for size comparison).

I've used the 'pump bottle' version for many years, and it's awesome. For the first time, I finally bought a smaller size for convenience. The smaller bottle with a flip cap is NOT the same consistency as what is in the larger pump bottles. The lotion came out of the flip cap bottle more transparent, not as thick or rich, and didn't absorb the same way as the lotion I've been using for over 5 years. I am VERY unhappy given how expensive these smaller bottles were! I felt the cost was ridiculous BEFORE buying them. Now that I know the lotion isn't the same, I feel like an idiot and even violated as a devoted long time customer. Just so we're clear... the lotion in the larger size pump bottles is excellent. It is thick, rich, odorless, and you can see a difference in your skin upon the first time using it. The lotion I received in the more expensive order containing three 2.5 oz flip cap bottles was NOT the same lotion, and is inferior quality by comparison to the 18 oz pump bottles. So, devoted buyers beware! Just buy your own smaller empty bottle to pump some of your 'known' lotion into. That way you know exactly what you're getting, and remain a satisfied customer.

avis.titre: Did Not Moisturize & Pump Was Broken!!!!
avis.texte: This Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Body Lotion had an amazing scent but fell short on the moisturizing part...MY HAND PUMP WAS BROKEM AND WOUOD NOT TWIST TO UNLOCK, SO I CPUPD NOT USE THE LOTION BY PUMPING IT MANUALLY BUT INSTEAD I HAD TO TWIST OFF THE ENTIRE LID... After using this lotion for the first time my hands were still cracked and dry along with my heals being rough still! Sadly every time i washed my hands i had to reapply and much more often compared to other lotions. I really really loved the scent though but wish this lotion would have moisturized my skin like the bottle states...Another thing is this lotion also had a more watery texture but not sure if it was because the hand pump did not work along with the bottom of my bottle dented in if that made a difference? But i had to unscrew the entire lid to be able to even use the lotion...But it still cane out if the bottle really fast and does not compare to other lotions much thicker texture..

That was acceptable and they are supposed to send me by snail mail a $10 check within 10 business days. We shall see. I will never buy this product again. The experience makes me wonder why my Amazon Prime account could not handle this refund. Very annoyed.

Only 2 days of using it, I've noticed that the bottle is almost half full! I still have the small bottle I'm using so I only used this big bottle only 2 days and only used very little.

It's nothing fancy and that's okay. Aveeno has always helped soothe my winter dry skin and its great for daily usage without feeling greasy. It has little, if any, fragrance which is a HUGE plus to me.

avis.titre: Best for delicate and dry skin
avis.texte: 100% recommended if you have very dry and delicate skin. It's scent free and it has an amazing and quick absorbing texture.
I like that it has fewer ingredients compared to other brands and fragrance free for my sensitive skin. I use it daily to stay moisturized.

I’ve been using Aveeno lotion for years, and it never disappoints! It moisturizes dry skin really well without feeling greasy, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft and smooth all day. It’s gentle, has a light scent, and the large bottle lasts a long time. Highly recommend for everyday use!

Truly lost as to how this lotion got such great reviews. I usually use the Hemp lotion but decided to wild out and give Johnson & Johnson another shot. I just put it on my body after my shower. Felt fine. Smelled fine. Sat down and ran my hand down my leg and felt clumps. Rubbed again, more clumps. It’s like I’m sloughing dead skin. Yet, it’s the lotion. Zero chance this lotion is absorbing being I look like I’m shedding an exoskeleton right now. Zero likes.

avis.texte: Damage to bottle. 4-6 oz. lost. “Not eligible for return.” I want replacement—you wouldn’t want this mess shipped back. Who in the world would ship a pump bottle of lotion in a paper bag with no protective layer? I only have so much time to spend on this, but dissatisfied barely describes it.

avis.titre: Delivered in box with broken cap
avis.texte: Delivered in box with a broken cap on one bottle. The underlying plastic is also broken so cap cannot be reattached.

avis.titre: Does not come with body wash, other products are good
avis.texte: Aveeno is one of my go-to brands and this “travel set” pretty good. I did order this set for the body wash, but the body wash doesn’t appear to be included like the images imply. I always really like their “restore + calm” line, so the face wipes and face moisturizer are excellent! They are soothing without being too greasy and they calm my skin down when it gets overly dry. These products truly do not have any fragrance, which is a huge bonus because I am sensitive to smells.

avis.titre: Amazing Set! Perfect for Travel or a Weekend Away! Really Good Deal On Quality Care.
avis.texte: Love this Aveeno travel essential set! I took it along on a recent business trip. This set of sort of my vibe, blending practicality and comfort, just what I want, a small splurge, not a huge big thing. Here're my thoughts. ➡️ PRODUCTS INCLUDED ✅ Daily Moisturizing Lotion I’ve used the full-size version before, and this travel size didn’t disappoint. Absorbs quickly, no greasy residue, and kept my skin hydrated through dry hotel air. The oat extract feels soothing, especially after sun exposure. ✅ Daily Moisturizing Body Wash Gentle and low-lather, which I prefer when traveling. Didn’t strip my skin, and the scent is subtle enough not to clash with other products. The bottle’s secure cap survived a bumpy ride without leaking. ✅ Calm + Restore Makeup Removing Wipes Fragrance-free and non-irritating—worked well even around the eyes. The wipe texture is soft but sturdy, and the resealable flap stayed shut, so they didn’t dry out. LOVE THESE! I'll use these even outside of travel. ✅ Calm + Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer This was the surprise favorite. Lightweight but effective, especially for reactive skin. It layered well under sunscreen and didn’t pill. The jar is tiny but perfect for short trips. ➡️ PACKAGING & PRESENTATION The winter-themed box is festive and giftable, though I bought it for personal use. TSA-compliant sizing is accurate, and the set fits easily into my carry on bag. ➡️ VERDICT A well-balanced kit for dry or sensitive skin, especially if you’re already an Aveeno

I was already looking to order a new bottle after my days skin/itching ( my bottle just ran out! It was making me Stressed Out & then I found a great Deal on this ~ phenomenal Price. Stress gives me hives at a certain point so this was my miracle for the week😊 The pump works just fine, I made sure after a few other reviews I saw. Either way bought during Prime Days deals. Win Win. I Cannot find this anywhere I shop at , so I’m extremely happy with this product Box was a perfect size. Many thanks to employees who took the time to package it just right

Aveeno moisturizing body lotion is a staple around our house so I thought to try the Aveeno Daily Travel Essentials Gift Set. It includes travel sizes of the body lotion, body wash, gel moisturizer, and makeup wipes. The body lotion and makeup wipes are fragrance free, and I think the gel moisturizer is as well. The body wash is described as "lightly scented" but it has far more fragrance than I like. The wipes are made of compostable plant-based material so instead of flushing just toss them in the green bin. Much better for the environment! All in all I think it's a decent way to get travel sizes of common Aveeno products, or to introduce someone new to Aveeno.

This set is really well put together for travel or just trying out some basics. I’ve been using the products for about two weeks now, and they’ve held up well in daily use, not just for short trips. The moisturizer is my favorite of the bunch. I like that it’s a gel formula instead of a heavy cream. It feels lightweight, sinks in fast, and works nicely under makeup without pilling. On my sensitive skin, it felt calming and kept dryness away throughout the day without making me oily. The body lotion and body wash are both fragrance-free, which is a big plus for me. The lotion absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel greasy, and the wash has a gentle lather that leaves my skin soft without any tightness afterward. Compared to other travel-size kits I’ve tried, I think this one stands out because the formulas feel closer to their full-size versions, not watered down. The makeup wipes are good and they remove makeup effectively, but the texture of the wipes themselves is a little rough. I wish they were softer or slicker, but they still get the job done and don’t leave behind residue. Overall, it’s a handy kit with solid products, and the sizes are perfect for throwing in my carry-on. The gel moisturizer alone makes it worth it for me, but the whole set has been a reliable option for both travel and everyday use.

I was so happy to have this set for my end of summer trip. All of the items are airplane travel size approved so it was easy to just throw this whole set in my carry on. I love that this set includes a full size package of 25 makeup wipes. These wipes are great for taking off makeup but also for freshening up your face after a flight! Aveeno is a brand I trust with my sensitive skin I love that these products do not cause my skin any irritation. The only item in this set that was new to me was the Calm and Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer and I love it!! With the gel moisturizer I felt a little goes a long way because it spreads very easily and I also loved that it did really well under my usual makeup. I also liked that the products work together well. Overall this is a great set I highly recommend for travel or for someone who wants to try out Aveeno skincare!!

The lotion top was not screwed on all the way, and there was also some lotion on the part you dispense from. Looks like someone used it before me. I don't trust it so I'm throwing it away. Waste of money.

avis.titre: Nice combo of essentials. Great gel moisturizer and gentle body wash.
avis.texte: This Aveeno Daily Travel Essentials contains one of my favorite moisturizers--the Calm+Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer. I have a hunch that Aveeno knows they have a good product on their hands and have been including it in quite a few of their gift sets. Individually it's a pretty pricey item. The oat gel moisturizer is lightweight yet very hydrating. It absorbs quickly and feels calming to the face. It's not the most occlusive however, so in dryer months I would reach for a different option or layer with another cream on top. During summer, it's pretty great. My face tends to get dry after a wash, and this helps keep my face hydrated for longer. The subjective feeling on the face is just really nice. The body lotion feels pretty standard and is hydrating. It absorbs well left my skin feeling soft and protected. The body wash was a nice surprise to me as well. It's very gentle and does a good job of cleansing without drying out skin.

I love that I can take all four of these items with me on a plane without an issue! The makeup wipes are perfect for on the go and a real lifesaver because I can’t get get my normal cleanser and toner in a travel size. I also don’t have to risk the hotel soap bring drying or the scent irritating my sensitive skin. I love all four items and that it’s ready to go wherever I go. Also, the price is great and it comes beautifully packaged as a gift.

This Aveeno Daily Travel Essentials kit is perfect for trips. The Daily Moisturizing Lotion keeps my skin soft and hydrated without feeling greasy. The Daily Moisturizing Body Wash leaves my skin clean and smooth while being gentle. The Calm + Restore Makeup Removing Wipes work well and don’t irritate my skin, and the Calm + Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer feels lightweight yet soothing. Everything is perfectly sized for travel and easy to pack. Also, could be given as a gift.

This is a wonderful travel gift set. It comes with four different products, all travel sized to throw in your carry-on. The moisturizer for the face is wonderful. It is light and blends very smoothly. I can already see a difference in my skin. The mini body wash lather as well and the lotion is moisturizing and helps my dry skin. I like having the make up removing wipes to help avoid having to dry out my face by continually washing it. The wipes remove the make up and dirt gently. All items are fragrance free, but do have that slight oatmeal Aveeno scent.

avis.titre: Feels sticky and defective label. Not the same Aveno as another stores.
avis.texte: I like Aveno, but for some reason this product is not like the ones that I bought before in other stores, it feels super sticky on the skin, plus the container has the label defective. Im not satisfied with this purchase at all.

This Aveeno Daily Travel Essentials Gift Set is the perfect set if you want to try a few products out prior to getting full size (although the Gel Moisturizer and Makeup Removing Wipes are full size!) - but it’s perfect to try a few of their products out first! It also would be great for traveling - or also stocking stuffers, teacher gifts, etc! I absolutely love Aveeno and have used and love all of these, especially the body lotion and gel moisturizer! Actually - all are amazing haha!

Great gift set with a nice selection of premium brand name Aveeno items. It comes in a nice gift box and is a great value for the price. Very happy with this. All items are in convenient travel size, perfect for your next trip.

avis.titre: Bad bottle cannot get the lotion out.
avis.texte: Too bad the product. The bottle is broken and I cannot get the lotion out.

avis.titre: A must for anyone that has dry skin
avis.texte: This Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Body Lotion is a true skincare essential! I've been using it for a while now, and I'm consistently impressed with how well it keeps my skin looking and feeling fresh. It absorbs quickly without any greasy residue, and my skin stays soft and hydrated all day long. If you're looking for a reliable and effective daily moisturizer, I highly recommend giving this one a try!

avis.titre: Aveeno is an amazing product to clear up skin rashes and irritations!!
avis.texte: About 3 months ago the doctors treated me for what they thought was poison oak then after 3 doctor visits, 2 ER visits, and a dermatologist appointment along with several prescription lotions and 2 steroid shots and steroid pills they determined it wasn’t poison oak but an allergic reaction but no idea as to what. After it had nearly totally cleared up after 2 months, it came back suddenly after first day at new job where I had been outside in the heat so then I was diagnosed as being sensitive to sun due to one of my medications. The rash was on my hands and arms including my palms, and was on my neck and edges of my face and around my waist and it itched worse than anything in my life has including poison oak and was now wearing long sleeve shirts at work to avoid sun exposure in 97 degree weather. Aveeno makes some nice products, but I do wish they wouldn't include petrochemicals in their products as often as they do, because some of them give me contact dermatitis, and all of them are bad for the environment. And it goes against their reputation and the fact that they call some of their petrolatum-containing products "active naturals," which leads people to think all the ingredients are natural when they're not. The Calm + Restore Makeup Removing Wipes work really well for me and can even remove waterproof mascara. The Calm + Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer unfortunately has butylene glycol which gives me contact dermatitis, so I can only use it occasionally to avoid peeling skin. The body wash is nice and has a pleasant, light scent. The Daily Moisturizing Body Wash unfortunately contains petrolatum, so I also can only use it occasionally. All of the products in this set have a smooth feel to them, and none of them feel sticky. If you're not sensitive to petrochemicals, you'd probably be happy with this set.

avis.titre: Didn't receive the full kit, likely others will face this as well.
avis.texte: My set arrived already open on the bottom, and unfortunately, the body wash was missing entirely, which was a disappointing start. So, while I can’t speak for the complete kit, I can review the items that did come. Focusing on the other 3 items in the kit, the products themselves are quite good for travel. The surprise favorite was the little jar of oat gel moisturizer for the face—it’s lightweight, feels calming on the skin, and is a decent portion for a short trip for me (1-2 weeks). The makeup removing wipes are also excellent; they’re gentle but effective, and the package actually stays sealed so they don't dry out. The travel-sized body lotion is as reliable as its full-sized counterpart, which is a dependable staple for dry skin. The concept is great. It’s a well-curated set of travel essentials that are perfectly sized for a carry-on, and it would also make a nice offering for houseguests. It’s just a shame about the quality control and the missing item. It's a really nice collection of products, assuming you receive all of them. I included a picture to show how it arrived, with the bottom blown out.

This is a very lightweight, but moisturizing lotion. I shy away from a lot of lotions due to not liking the greasiness they leave. This one actually spreads out very thinly and does not leave a grimy feeling on my hands, which I appreciate. This lotion is best for the legs in my opinion. I prefer something just a little heavier on my hands and elbows in the winter for added protection. The scent is very light and a bit earthy. It is definitely a good lotion for those with sensitive skin. The bottles are average sized, and it is a bit below-average for the overall value, but is a trusted brand and product.

There is a new look to the bottle, but the ingredient list remains the same (please see pics). The consistency is the same, the moisturizing power is still there, and I love that there is no added fragrance. It's very effective at sealing in moisture. I've been using this for 7+ years, will probably be using it for at least 7 more!

avis.titre: LOVE this lotion -- but wish there was a better way to "get it all out" from the bottom
avis.texte: I LOVE the Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Lotion for Dry Skin. It is fragrance free and goes on smooth and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling oily or slick. It's strong enough to keep my skin moisturized (so long dry itchy feeling!) and gentle enough to use on my face. I keep a bottle of this at my desk at work and every time I wash my hands I return to my desk to put some on! It has a "soothing oatmeal" which keeps my hands feeling smooth. My ONLY complaint (and it's not even enough of a complaint to deduct a star) is that it is IMPOSSIBLE to get the last remaining bits out of the bottom of the container. I continued using the lotion bottle for weeks after the pump no longer pulled the lotion out (despite multiple attempts of shaking the bottle to re-position the lotion in the bottom) by removing the cap and pulling the interior tube out to get what had "caught" on the inside. I want to get my money's worth, and this stuff is too good to just throw away!

avis.titre: Good gift box if you get a sealed one
avis.texte: Repacked gift set with all items unsealed. Good package in theory - carry on friendly bottle sizes, good variety of products - moisturizer, body wash, lotion and wipes. All from a known name brand. But, the package is not factory sealed. I have used Aveeno products for years and each one of these come from factory with an aluminum / heat shrunk seal. None of the included lotions or bodywash were sealed. They didn't look used or returned either - more like repacked after the fact. The gift box itself - while good looking, was sealed on top, and opened from base, with all products piled back in from the wrong side. The products look good, and may even be unused, but would not put an unsealed item from internet on my body. Good concept, known brand and meaningful gift idea, unfortunately not fresh. Would not recommend!

avis.titre: Is a dupe not the real product
avis.texte: This is absolutely NOT Aveeno lotion. Been using the real stuff for years. The real stuff is effective and does as advertised. However, the lotion this Amazon bottle dispenses is a different texture and smell from the original. It is very similar at first but way greasier and doesn’t absorb into skin. Also, the bottle from my old and new lotions look different. Lighter green print on the Amazon one than the real thing. I would’ve chalked that up to new company packaging, except I realized they’re 100% the same except for that, and the new one doesn’t have an expiration date like the old one does. So personally I think this is either a dupe, a watered down version, or expired. Either way save yourself the trouble and go to the store, since you actually have no idea what this bottle contains if it is a fake (and it most likely is).

This lotion is exactly what I needed. My skin gets really cracked and dry after showers or washing my hands, and in the last few weeks it's gotten especially bad (and quite painful at times). I use it every time my hands get wet (i.e. after a shower or washing my hands), and as advertised, the lotion is fragrance-free, although it does have a faint scent which may come from the oatmeal used in the product.

avis.titre: Great solid lotion with no fragrance and great for people with sensitive skin
avis.texte: Before discovering this Aveeno Active Naturals Daily Moisturizing Lotion, I used various lotions that just made my pores and skin feel clogged and oily. This is such a great overall lotion for people with sensitive-prone and very dry skin. The lotion virtually has no fragrance and its scent is extremely subtle. I can seriously feel the lotion sink into and moisturize my skin like a desert plant thirsting for water. The texture of the lotion is just right and glides onto skin smoothly. Your skin will feel like a baby's bottom if you use this consistently. That being said, I feel that this is an ideal body lotion and the price on Amazon is reasonable compared to purchasing it at the drugstore. The pump on the bottle is also convenient and hygienic. I don't use this lotion for my face, however, as my facial skin is exceptionally sensitive. I prefer to use a face-specific lotion or moisturizer for my face. However, this Aveeno Active Naturals Daily Moisturizing Lotion is one of my favorite lotions along with Moisturel, another one that I love. I purchased this product as an add-on item on Amazon and always go back to it whenever I run out. Great solid lotion with no fragrance and great for people with sensitive skin.
